text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on getting through the

preliminaries!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I was on the edge of my seat. It was so
amazing, I
could hardly believe it was a
preliminary!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the semifinals, where all the
other heavy hitters from today will
battle it out. I
expect the competition
will be steep.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good to hear! You two keep raising the
bar with
every run!
